summary: Updated the reference/MC/Trace suite and generated Update.tla for the ValidateUpdate rewrite; rebased harness traces all validate. Model checking found one update-introduced defect (MC-1), reproduced on the updated source: an unchanged, already reached VoteExtensionsEnableHeight update is rejected and halts the chain permanently.
validation_limits: All model-checking results are bounded (heights <= 3 in BFS, <= 5 in simulation; symbolic non-ABCI parameters); LIMITED_COVERAGE, not proof.
Single node and single code version: rolling binary upgrades across a restart, validator-set changes, Byzantine behaviour and I/O faults are not modeled.
Mock final-block replay of a changed vote-extension height was reached only in the model, not in a runtime trace.

The requirement behind UnchangedVENotRejected is contested at unit-test level (new test data expects ValidateUpdate to error); the ABCI contract and the old unit test treat the unchanged value as compliant.
The bug-confirmation controller and 'specula ci-result' were not available; the reproduction was run directly (harness/repro_MC-1.sh) and this file was not validated by the CLI.

findings.title: Unchanged, already-reached VoteExtensionsEnableHeight update is rejected — permanent chain halt
findings.cause: The updated ConsensusParams.ValidateUpdate removed the old unchanged-value short-cut, so row 6 (types/params.go:243-248) rejects an Abci update whose VoteExtensionsEnableHeight equals the current, already reached value (P = U, P <= h), while rows 3 and 9 still accept unchanged values.
findings.trigger: With vote extensions enabled at a height P <= h (e.g. at the initial height), the application returns a FinalizeBlock ConsensusParamUpdates whose Abci sub-record repeats P, for example by forwarding its complete parameter set (ToProto always sets Abci).
findings.consequence: updateState fails after the response is durable, ApplyBlock errors and consensus/blocksync panic; every restart replays the stored block through the real app and is rejected again, so the handshake fails and the chain halts permanently.

premises: The application may return a non-nil ConsensusParamUpdates whose Abci sub-record repeats the current VoteExtensionsEnableHeight (non-empty fields are applied in full).
Any updateState error after the response save is fatal for consensus/blocksync and recurs on handshake replay.
